issues.title: G6 A arm execution semantics do not match the G6/G7 protocol
issues.evidence: The G6 protocol defines G6_A_G3_GIVEN as the derived G3 Tools+Iteration arm. The frozen project runner scripts/run_g6_counterfactual.py instead gives G3 no tools, exactly two fixed-reflection model calls, and rejects G3 tool calls; docs/experiment_groups.md and configs/experiment_groups.json confirm the same implementation. The existing 552-row corrected subset therefore cannot be treated as a verified G6 Tools+Iteration run.
issues.remediation: Keep the historical G6 artifacts immutable. Freeze an explicit corrected G3 Tools+Iteration adapter, run it against the verified 23-family denominator with the same public inputs, matched G4 controls, hard limits, raw traces, and 2 workers; re-audit and use only the corrected handoff for G7.
